contentPattern.structure: thumbnail image + linked heading + description paragraph

suitableFor: article/resource listing grids where each card links to an article
3-up (and many-row) photo-thumbnail cards with a linked heading and a short description
topic-grouped content hubs and learning-center landing pages
notSuitableFor: icon-led navigation tiles with no description body (use cards-bop-tile)
icon coverage/feature cards with a learn-more link (use cards-coverage)
category overview sections on grey backgrounds (use cards-category)
image promo tiles without a heading+description article pattern (use cards-tile)
